clusters.title: The overlay clones split the accessibility tree: the column headers read after the data, each row is exposed twice, the row headers sit apart from their rows, and a screen reader loses the cell's row index (VoiceOver with Chromium names a cell's column one lower)
The grid is built from divs with ARIA roles, and its treegrid root holds children the role does not allow

The focus is not returned to the cell after Escape, Enter, Tab or a shortcut closes an editor, a menu or the comment editor, or an arrow key closes a submenu: it stays on the closed editor's field or falls to the document, and a screen reader does not announce the cell or the parent item

With imeFastEdit the browser focus sits in the editor's hidden input while a cell is only selected, so a date or time cell reads as that input (`Year, spin button, 2024`, `6 month stepper`) or not at all, VoiceOver differently from run to run, and Enter, which opens the editor without a focus move, is silent on NVDA with Firefox

The formula builder's editor puts the combobox role on a textarea, which ARIA in HTML does not allow, and names a closed list in aria-controls: VoiceOver reads only the typed text, neither the suggestion that typing highlights nor the function help the editor names as its description, and with WebKit an empty list (`0 items`); and its options' ids follow their place in the list, so when typing refilters it and the active option stays first, aria-activedescendant keeps its value and NVDA with Chromium says nothing (NVDA with Firefox reads the new option)
The formula builder's error cell points aria-errormessage at its error popup, a tooltip with no live region, which axe rejects
Moving the focus onto the formula editor with Tab or Shift+Tab changes the context, which a focus move alone must not do
Text, icon, checkbox, grid line, selection and focus indicator contrast under 4.5:1 or 3:1 per theme

An announcement or an accessibility tree differs from its golden with no defect behind it: reader wording that varies between runs (the echo of typed characters catches more or fewer of them, a status message can cut short what VoiceOver reads before it, and VoiceOver with WebKit names a menu item's group one way or another), a golden that recorded a start-up silence the run did not repeat, and a reading golden recorded a phrase late; record the golden again
A page has no tab-order or accessibility-tree golden recorded yet
axe's experimental hidden-content rule lists every hidden element for review: the overlay clones' hidden rows, the closed editors and menus
The scrolling holder is not keyboard focusable, though every cell in it is: axe cannot tell and lists it for review
Links in the docs prose are told apart from the surrounding text by color alone
Links, menu triggers, post tags and the slider on handsontable.com show no focus indicator, and none in forced colors
The text fields in the dark footer of handsontable.com have an edge and a fill below 3:1 against the footer
Most pages of handsontable.com are reached by its navigation only: the site has no search and no site map page
